ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the flow-direction arrow of the river points to the left, indicating that the river flows from right to left. The river channel is curved, forming an obvious bend protruding upward near the right side; Yi is located near the outer concave bank on the upper side of this bend, Jia is located near the inner side of the bend, and Bing and Ding are located at other curved parts. Reasoning: In a river bend, the inertia of the water flow makes the water flow velocity at the outer concave bank faster and the scouring effect strong, while the water flow at the inner convex bank is slower and deposition is dominant. In the figure, Yi is at the outer concave bank of the bend, so among the four places, the one most significantly affected by flowing-water erosion is Yi.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中河流由右向左流，河道在右侧形成一处向上凸出的明显弯道，乙标在该弯道的外侧凹岸附近。再推理：根据河曲发育规律，弯道外侧凹岸受水流冲刷最强，内侧凸岸以堆积为主，所以四地中流水侵蚀最显著的是乙处。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中河流的流向箭头指向左侧，表示河流由右向左流。河道呈弯曲形态，在右侧附近形成一处向上凸出的明显弯道；乙位于该弯道上侧的外侧凹岸附近，甲位于弯道内侧附近，丙、丁位于其他弯曲部位。推理：河流弯道中，水流惯性使外侧凹岸水流速度较快、冲刷作用强，内侧凸岸水流较缓、以堆积为主。图中乙处处在弯道外侧凹岸，因此四地中受流水侵蚀作用最显著的是乙处。
